speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent, and I need to begin my examination of you. To start, how old are you in days, and have you noticed any fever, excessive sleepiness, or difficulty breathing?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Sepsis (likely Group B Streptococcus or E. coli)

Given the lack of prenatal care and unknown immunization status, your newborn is at high risk for early-onset sepsis. I need to know if she has any other specific symptoms, such as poor feeding, lethargy, or jaundice, and I will immediately request a complete blood count and blood culture.
